description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Base64 class, which handles base64 encoding and decoding of data for XML-RPC values within the Zend Framework. It provides a constructor to set the value (optionally already encoded) and a method to retrieve the decoded string.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Base64
classes.description: A class representing a base64-encoded XML-RPC value, capable of encoding and decoding data to and from base64 format as required by the XML-RPC protocol.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class, setting the value with optional pre-encoding.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the base64-decoded string value stored in this object.
